fields.description: Program Description Overview A globalized commercial and industrial environment calls for private and public-owned enterprises to work internationally, generating growing demand of talents with a deep understanding of international economy practice and strategy. SUFE’s International Economy & Trade degree course is developed to equip the students with profound knowledge of the global business and proficient skills in financial accounting, Ecommerce, and international marketing. Modules Students need to obtain 148 credits in total, of which 123 for in-class courses and 25 for community immersion, computer skill test and thesis. Main Courses YEAR 1 Chinese History Chinese Culture Overview of China P.E Mathematics Microeconomics Management Operations Research Business Chinese(intermediate level) YEAR 2 Liner Algebra Probability Management Information System Macroeconomics Economic Law Financial Accounting Object-oriented Programming Design Discrete Mathematics Financial Management World Economy International Economics I YEAR 3 Philosophy Monetary Banking Industrial Economics International Economics II International Trade Practice Marketing E-Commerce International Political Economics Foreign Trade Policy Comparative Economics History of World Economy Entrepreneurship YEAR 4 International Business International Trade in Service Special Topics on International Trade International Marketing Entrepreneurial Marketing Thesis *The courses above are subject to change. Please refer to the syllabus after registration. Career Paths Typical career paths could be in international business, research and evaluation on international trade in public sectors and enterprises.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Chinese visa/residence permit For those living in the Chinese mainland at the time of application. * 2. One reference letter The letter should be recent, dated, in English/Chinese, and with referee's contact details (employer, position, email, phone number). * 3. Foreigner's Physical Examination Report The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the “Foreigner Physical Examination Form”Foreigner Physical Examination Form.pdf The form you submit must: Include with the signature of the attending physicians Include with the official stamp of the hospital Include with a sealed photograph of the applicant Be written in English, and Be dated within the last 6 months. Please keep the original reports with you for later use when you register at the University. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Police Clearance Certificate Please go to your local police authority where you reside, request that the police conduct a local or state criminal records search and provide you with a document reflecting that there is no history of a criminal record. The Police Clearance Certificate should be dated within the last 6 months. If you are unable to maintain such a document due to unforeseen circumstances, please contact Admission Office as early as possible for alternative documentation. 5. Certificates recognizing awards & merits if any * 6. Others Documents Required If you have studied or are currently studying at an institution in China, please upload your transcripts, completion certificates, or proof of enrollment, etc.; If you have never studied in China yet, please upload your personal resume. * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Passport identification page Your passport should be valid beyond January 31, 2027. * 9. Photo Please use the ID photo taken within the last 6 months. The head in the photograph must be facing the camera straight on, and the face may not be obscured. The photo itself must be in color, but the background needs to be white or blue. Head coverings are prohibited. * 10. High school academic transcript You need to apply with academic transcript for all the courses taken from high school grade one. It would be appreciated that the transcript is attached with a clarification on the grading system and how your GPA is calculated. Certified English/Chinese translations are required if the original documents are neither in English nor in Chinese. * 11. High school diploma If you are in the final year, please upload a certificate indicating the entry and the expected completion date. Certified English/Chinese translations are required if the original documents are neither in English nor in Chinese. * 12. Personal statement It should be written in Chinese, 800-1000 words including the applicant's education (and working experience, if applicable), study plan, etc. and enclosed with the applicant's signature. * 13. Guarantee of Financial Support Your program application will not be processed without a funding documentation. Your personal sponsor should be able to provide full financial support for your educational and living expenses for the entire length of study at SUFE. Ask your personal sponsor to complete the appropriate sections of the form Guarantee of Financial Support.pdf and provide a scanned copy of his/her passport, or ID card of the sponsor is of Chinese nationality. The form you submit must: Provide correct and complete information Include with the signature of the sponsor, and Be written in English or Chinese You can download a template or sample from here . * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements In order to be considered for admission, you must: -be a non-Chinese citizen, 18-45 years old, in good health, -have completed senior high school education or will receive a high school diploma by the summer before matriculation at SUFE in September 2026, AND -meet the Chinese language requirements through HSK: If your intended major is Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages , the entry requirement is HSK 4 ; applicants of other majors should present HSK 5, score 180 or above certification at the time of application. -It is mandatory to take the CSCA test and get the score report in advance. All the applicants, no matter which major you apply for, must sit the Math test. You can choose either Chinese test or English test. Humanities Chinese test result is not required if your intended major is Teaching Chinese to speakers of Other Languages. Applicants of other majors must take Humanities Chinese test. Important: It is advisable to take the CSCA test at an early date. The CSCA tests are designed to provide an objective measure of a student's proficiency in core subjects such as Math, Chinese language, and the test scores play a crucial role in the admission decision making process.
